title: Length of an encoded nonempty list
statement: For a function $f$ from a type $\alpha$ to bit strings, an element $a\in\alpha$, and a list $as$ of elements of $\alpha$, the encoding of $a::as$ has length $1+|f(a)|+|\operatorname{encode}(as)|$, where the list encoding uses $f$.
hypotheses_covered: A function $f$ assigning a bit string to each element
